title: Boosting the Learning for Ranking Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2610.16511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pattern mining is a valuable tool for exploratory data analysis, but identifying relevant patterns for a specific user is challenging. Various interestingness mea- sures have been developed to evaluate patterns, but they may not efficiently estimate user-specific functions. Learning user-specific functions by ranking patterns has been proposed, but this requires significant time and training samples. In this paper, we present a solution that formulates the problem of learning pattern ranking functions as a multicriteria decision making problem. Our approach uses Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to elicit weights for different interestingness measures based on user preference. We also propose an active learning mode with a sensitivity-based heuristic to minimize user ranking queries while still providing high-quality results. translated_title: 提升模式排序的学习效果
translated_abstract: 模式挖掘是探索性数据分析的一种有价值的工具，但为特定用户识别相关模式具有挑战性。目前已开发了多种趣味性度量来评估模式，但它们可能无法有效估计用户特定的函数。通过模式排序来学习用户特定函数的方法已被提出，但这需要大量的时间和训练样本。在本文中，我们提出了一种解决方案，将学习模式排序函数的问题表述为一个多准则决策问题。我们的方法使用层次分析法（AHP）根据用户偏好为不同的趣味性度量获取权重。我们还提出了一种带有基于敏感度启发式方法的主动学习模式，以最小化用户排序查询次数，同时仍然提供高质量的结果。实验表明，我们的方法显著减少了运行时间，并能返回精确的模式排序结果。
tldr: 本文将模式排序函数学习问题转化为多准则决策问题，利用层次分析法（AHP）根据用户偏好获取趣味性度量权重，并结合基于敏感度启发式的主动学习模式，在显著减少运行时间和用户查询次数的同时实现精确的模式排序。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates learning pattern ranking functions as a multicriteria decision-making problem, using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to elicit weights for interestingness measures based on user preference, combined with a sensitivity-based active learning mode to significantly reduce running time and user ranking queries while achieving precise pattern ranking.
